summary: Retest after iteration_1 fixes. All 3 target fixes VERIFIED. 36/36 pytest pass (100%). FIX#1 admin/products create returns 200 with id (no _id). FIX#2 super_admin starts at current_stage=1, wallet=0. FIX#3 MLM e2e works: after 3 fresh hamper-joining orders sponsored by ADMIN001, admin advanced to current_stage=2, wallet_balance=₹500, commission_wallet=500, transactions shows 'Stage 1 completion commission' credit. ONE NEW REGRESSION found: POST /api/auth/register intermittently returns 500 DuplicateKeyError on user_code because generation uses count_documents+1 which is non-monotonic when historical users have been deleted (gaps in user_code sequence cause collisions). Unblocked by wiping orphan TEST_ users.

critical.issue: user_code generation is non-atomic and gap-unsafe. server.py L141-142: user_code = f"EG{(count_documents+1):06}". Before cleanup, DB had 8 users with user_codes including gaps (EG000003/06 missing, max=EG000010). count=8 → new code = EG000009, which already existed → DuplicateKeyError 11000. Fix options: (a) compute max(user_code) + 1, or (b) use a dedicated counters collection (findOneAndUpdate $inc) for atomic monotonic sequence, or (c) retry on DuplicateKeyError. Also affects concurrent registrations.

minor.issue: sponsor_id field still stores sponsor user_code (e.g. EG000001) — name remains misleading (carried from iteration_1).
Returns a raw list whereas /api/admin/users and /api/admin/orders return {items,total}. Inconsistent pagination shape across admin endpoints.

rca_of_the_issue.register_500_duplicate_user_code: Trace: server.py register() L141 → user_count = await db.users.count_documents({}); L142 → user_code = f'EG{(user_count+1):06}'. After iteration_1, DB had 8 user docs but user_codes had gaps (EG000003 and EG000006 had been deleted, while EG000009/10 still existed). count_documents returned 8, so the next code computed as EG000009 — already present → unique index on user_code raised DuplicateKeyError → handler returned 500. Mitigation applied: wiped non-admin users to make the sequence contiguous. Permanent fix: switch to atomic monotonic counter (counters collection with findOneAndUpdate $inc, or max(user_code)+1 with retry on duplicate).
